patch_description:
Replace the 24-independent-param-per-block design with a 4-shared-param interleaved architecture. The ansatz alternates collective rotation layers (RY, RX, RZ, RY) with pairs of CZ perfect matchings from the complete graph. This:
1. Drops from 146 to 26 total params, eliminating the parameter penalty
2. Interleaves rotations and entanglers in 4 sub-blocks for better expressivity
3. Uses RY-RX-RZ-RY sequence for good Bloch sphere coverage
4. Each rotation acts on partially entangled states, unlike grouping all rotations first
5. Complete graph CZ coverage (all 28 edges) maintains strong entanglement
